About The College
Goals and Objectives of the College
Raha College started its mission with zeal to promote higher education to the largely underdeveloped people of Raha locality since its inception in 1964. The mission of the College is to serve the rural youths by providing them with easy access to higher education and job opportunities. The College will strive towards integrated personality, growth of rural students in particular and students at large in which special attention is given to their intellectual, moral and cultural development. Another important objective of the College is to inculcate the spirit of inquisitiveness among the students and to instill in them the spirit of patriotism, dedication and humanistic values.

Dear Students...!
				As you begin a new journey of your life, I heartily welcome you all to pursue higher education at Raha College for the academic session 2023-2024. Raha College has a glorious history of 58 years in imparting higher
education to the poor, needy and socially disadvantaged group of students of Raha and its adjoining areas. Our vision is to serve the social needs and to uplift the living standards of the rural youths by imparting higher
education and fostering an enduring sense of discipline and single minded dedication to work. Our objective is to help students realize their true potential so that they can face the challenges of life.
From The Principal's Desk
Dr. Beda Kumar Chaliha (M.A., B.Ed. Ph.D.)
